name: machete
description: A brush blade with a taped grip. It goes through most things in one stroke and it does not announce you doing it — but the edge rolls, and rolled steel bruises rather than cuts.
notes: T81 · bladed, the quiet answer to armor: pierce 1 against noise 12. It wears fastest of anything here (4 a swing on 60) — 'reliable, silent, wears' (GDD IX), with the wear as the bill.
